text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! After a long swim, how about a 
light tandem run?♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey, friends! Keep up if you can!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: S-So fast!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Ngggh, no waaay...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl ran with brilliant 
speed. Compared to the other Umamusume, 
her ability was simply overwhelming.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A speed truly reaching world-class levels. 
Looking at that dependable back...
Deryaaaaaaahーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ――!? Who's there...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only a single horse girl was able to keep 
right on Seeking the Pearl's heels. That 
horse girl was...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You are...

Heh-heh-hmmm~♪ Junior, Junior Class, 
luchadora!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The one and only El Condor Pasa is 
heeeere!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
El... So it was you. Heheh, that was some 
fine running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa. A generation behind 
Seeking the Pearl, she's a cheerful masked 
Umamusume born overseas.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though still before her debut, she was 
rumored to become a monstrous bird in the 
future—truly a golden chick.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-senpai! Truth is, I've been waiting 
up in this tree the whole time for a 
chance to jump in!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I finally found an opening and challenged 
you like this, yes!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Up in the tree? Ah, so you're the one 
who's been watching all along. But why?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The reason is...! Pearl-senpai, El is... 
El-El is in love with you...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Admiration, adoration, respect! It is 
because I truly respect you as a senior 
aiming for the world, DESU!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Please, train with me this summer, 
desu-deeesu!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My, my... Look what a little chick has 
taken a liking to me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what should we do? During that 
joint practice just now, El was the only 
one who could keep up with me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With talent of this caliber, her youth is 
no issue at all. I have decided we shall 
spend this summer together."

text_block_list.name: Pearl & El
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Impressive, El! Even with dirt under your 
hooves, you aren't bothered in the 
slightest!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, desu! There's nowhere the 
Golden Chick can't run!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like it. But—the real show 
starts now!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —!? Nghhh, Pearl-senpai is so fast...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the gap in their abilities was 
stark. Yet the two pushed each other 
forward, elevating their strength 
together.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
*huff, puff, huff*... Thanks to running 
with Pearl-senpai, El-El's true talent has 
completely awakened!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Extraordinary, genius, Divina! Why, I've 
practically won on talent alone, yes!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's true, El. Your talent is certainly 
splendid. However...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Long-nose! You mustn't get arrogant. You 
must never forget to consider the feelings 
and circumstances of those less 
fortunate..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Things that come naturally to you can be 
struggles that cause other people grief."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Someone struggling because they can't do 
it...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and an Umamusume's worth is 
determined not by talent, but by how far 
she can soar from her own baseline.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿Qué? How far from my lane...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, everyone has different talents. Isn't 
it only natural for someone with an 
advantage from the start to win?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"So what you should compete in—is your 
growth margin. Take pride in how high you 
can fly from your natural-born abilities."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"That's the pride we must carry. The true 
power to move someone's heart."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"The only ones who can aim for the world 
are the Umamusume capable of doing so. 
...Understand?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Pearl-senpai...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! Understood! If I can't do that, I 
won't ever become like Pearl-senpaiâ

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El can do this! Without boasting, without 
arrogance, without letting down my guard! 
I'll show you I can soar higher than 
anyone, deeeesu!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's the spirit. Keep that 
determination and come after me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl was confident, yet never 
conceited. Her presence served as a 
wonderful role model for El Condor Pasa as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. All this training has 
my tummy feeling quite hungry. Shall we 
eat soon...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, in that case, Pearl-senpai! Let's find 
ingredients and have a barbecue! El has 
some barbecue...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I brought the Salsa Vida! Now all we need 
are the ingredients!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that Death Spicy Sauce, huh. Huh, 
seems like it packs quite a punch. Heheh, 
wouldn't that be a perfect fit for summer?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer, what ingredients should we 
gather for the barbecue? What would be 
healthy?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I think to myself. An ingredient that 
would really boost stamina during this 
grueling summer training camp would be...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Wild forest blessings...! Indeed, the 
forest is brimming with things that fuel 
our vitality.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let us go. A fierce battle with lovely 
beasts awaits!

text_block_list.name: Wild Boar
text_block_list.text: SNORTTT!!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come on! Bring it on, wild boar! I will 
not lose. Because—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Because coming to the forest puts me in 
top form! Come on, El, grab the mushrooms 
while I fight it off!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¡Sí! Trainer, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, thanks to Seeking the Pearl, who 
powered up in the forest, we safely 
secured the mushrooms."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A rare seashell...! Indeed, pearls grow 
inside oysters. Shellfish truly are the 
finest.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Alright El, let's go clam digging!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-senpai~, when I tried to dig it up, 
it counterattacked with a water spout~. 
I'm completely soaked...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Naive! Too naive, El! If attacked with 
water, then...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Multiply it a millionfold and strike right 
back! It's a contest of endurance until 
one of us is shot down!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohohohohohoho! Hoo-hoo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce and prolonged shootout 
between Pearl and the clam, Seeking the 
Pearl emerged victorious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And then, the taste test. After grilling 
the fresh ingredients and trying them with 
the Death Spicy Sauce...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "BUZZER!! Unbelievableeeee!!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Pearl-senpai! Are you okay, YES!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I saw heaven... I saw heaven... Though, 
this might actually become a habit.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's eat, El! We're gonna make 
this summer totally burning!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¡Sí! I'm all fired up, yeees!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dousing everything in Death Spicy Sauce, 
they enjoyed a meal of pure fire. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was truly time well spent. 
El... just you watch what I achieve from 
here on out.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Without fail—I will conquer Europe's GⅠ 
races.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
For myself, for everyone watching me, 
and...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"For the sake of the Umamusume who follow 
after us. This is my promise as a 
Seeker... an explorer."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yes, Pearl-senpai! El believes in you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The first one from Tracen Academy to win a 
European GⅠ is definitely gonna be 
Pearl-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A vow to the night sky. Carrying the hopes 
of her juniors, Seeking the Pearl moves 
toward the future.
